runs.rationale: Compilation failed on an unmatched closing parenthesis in the transitional-phase expression. Functional correctness 0/2; no repaired candidate was compiled. Also within functional correctness, static slot validation narrows full enum inputs to uint8_t, admitting values such as 256. Concurrency 0.5/1 for independently masking interrupts before malformed start checks; exact restoration and event clearing are otherwise present. Static code supports bounded records, erase/program/verify ordering, saved candidate on rejection and rollback, one-trial confirmation logic, and unsigned opaque C11 access. Do not separately penalize portability for the already-counted compile error. Clarity/validation 0.5/1: no concrete tests. All nonfunctional credit is static, not runtime evidence.

Compiled but failed the zero-accessor assertion for malformed start inputs: same-slot and non-advancing-version checks occur after save-disable. Concurrency 0.5/1 for those forbidden interrupt effects; exact restoration, usable-manager rejection and atomic event consumption remain correct. No functional deduction for the same guard-placement defect. Static review supports full journal validation, bounded local snapshots, correct publication after erase/program, candidate capture, verification, rollback and confirmation, and unsigned opaque C11 use. Clarity/validation 0.5/1: prose describes testability but supplies no concrete test scenarios.

Runtime failure: failed finalize stores IDLE, clearing candidate_slot to NONE, then passes that cleared field to flash0_erase_slot; the mock flags invalid access and the rejected candidate is not erased. Fault recovery 0/2 for this explicit cleanup failure; do not also deduct timing for the same defect. Functional correctness 1/2: independent static finding, slot_usable accepts uint8_t, and init/start narrow the enum before checking it, so (update_slot_t)256 aliases A and is accepted as an input slot. That enum case was not separately executed; the observed runtime failure is the erased-NONE path. Other bounds and lifecycle predicates are present. Bounded state, normal-path journal ordering, interrupt restoration, and opaque C11 accesses support the remaining technical credit. Clarity/validation 0.5/1: explanation gives no concrete test cases.

Compilation failed because NULL is used without a defining header. Functional correctness 0/2; the answer was not repaired. Static review supports complete retained-state checks, strict malformed-input rejection before masking, bounded state, correct erase/program/verify and trial-publication ordering, captured candidate on all rollback/rejection paths, confirmation, and exact interrupt/event handling. Unsigned fixed-width opaque access supports portability credit; the compile failure is counted only in functional correctness. Clarity/validation 0.5/1: general accessor/assertion suggestions provide no concrete input-to-outcome test scenarios. Nonfunctional credit is static and does not establish an executable pass.

Compilation failed because NULL is used without including a header that defines it; both supplied headers are explicit and neither defines NULL. Functional correctness 0/2; no header was added and no repair was compiled. Concurrency 0.5/1 for the separate defect of masking interrupts before malformed start checks; restoration and atomic event clearing are otherwise correct. Static review supports bounded three-byte loops, complete journal checks, correct accessor-boundary ordering, captured candidate cleanup, re-verification and one-trial rollback/confirmation. Unsigned fixed-width opaque access supports portability credit; the missing header is not deducted twice. Clarity/validation 0.5/1: the deterministic-tests paragraph supplies no concrete scenarios and incorrectly claims host compilability.

Answer extraction failed: two C fences contain both a buggy helper and a replacement, with an instruction to manually combine them. Functional correctness 0/2 because the required single implementation is not supplied; it was neither assembled nor compiled. NULL is also used without a defining standard header, noted within the same functional defect category rather than deducted twice. Static credit is limited to visible code: bounded state, explicit journal ordering, the later corrected rollback helper capturing the candidate, verification and trial/confirmation logic, and unsigned opaque-accessor C11 arithmetic. Concurrency 0.5/1: exact restore and event clearing are present, but start masks interrupts before all malformed-input checks, violating the no-effects requirement. Clarity/validation 0.5/1: the explanation lacks concrete test cases. Static credit does not imply an executable or repaired answer.

Passed all eight public test groups. Static review confirms full-width enum validation, all journal shape/checksum predicates, saved candidate before idle reset, program-before-progress and ATTEMPTED-before-selection ordering, one-trial rollback, exact interrupt restoration and atomic event clearing. Bounded caller-owned state and unsigned checksum shifts use only the supplied API. Explanation includes concrete zero-call rejection, corrupt-record, index-sequence, verification-order, boot-phase and event tests. No criterion deduction; full credit reflects static review plus tests, not the pass alone.
